أتصادم (form VI)
# أَتَصَادَمُ (ʔataṣādamu) /ʔa.ta.sˤaː.da.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَصَادَمَ (taṣādama)
# أَتَصَادَمَ (ʔataṣādama) /ʔa.ta.sˤaː.da.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَصَادَمَ (taṣādama)
# أَتَصَادَمْ (ʔataṣādam) /ʔa.ta.sˤaː.dam/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَصَادَمَ (taṣādama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
